description: Creates or reuses a named thread under an existing job ID. Pass the returned thread_id as _session_id to append work from another AI client.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_session_id.description: Existing Zambo job ID that will own the new thread.

name.description: Short name that another AI can use to identify this work thread.
